commands.title: Start voice input
commands.description: Start an utterance: args {pointer: {device: "mac"|"phone", section, selection: {session?, task?, file?, line?}}, lang?: "ru"|"auto", mode?: "assistant"|"dictation"} (default ru, assistant). dictation goes to no session: voice.end tidies the text with Claude Haiku and the utterance ends done with it as text. Returns {utterance}. Phase is loading while the recognizer loads its model (audio is kept), else listening. Fails with "voice needs uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)" when uv is not installed.

commands.title: Send voice audio
commands.description: Feed audio to an utterance: 16 kHz mono PCM s16le, base64, 320 ms chunks recommended, at most 64 KiB raw per call. Returns the partial text heard so far. After 60 s of audio the rest is cut and the utterance ends itself. Fails with unknown utterance once it ended or was cancelled.

partial.description: Text heard so far, before the dictionary.

commands.title: End voice input
commands.description: Stop listening and return the final text with the user dictionary applied; the assistant then routes it in the background (follow voice.changed and voice.state).

commands.title: Cancel voice input
commands.description: Cancel an utterance at any phase; a pending confirmation is declined.

commands.title: Voice input state
commands.description: Current state of an utterance: {utterance, mode, phase, partial?, heard?, text?, plan?, result?, error?, confirm?: {title, command, args}, session?, rev}. phase is loading, listening, sending, thinking, confirm, done, error or cancelled. A dictation goes listening, thinking (tidying), done with text.

commands.title: Confirm voice action
commands.description: Answer the confirmation an utterance waits for (phase confirm): approve runs the action, decline ends the utterance with result cancelled.

approve.description: true runs the action, false declines it.

confirm.description: The id of the confirmation the user saw (State.confirm.id); a different pending one fails with "the confirmation changed". Omit to answer whatever is pending.

commands.title: Voice plan
commands.description: Voice session only: show the user one line saying what you will do with this utterance, in the user's language. Call it first. Non-destructive.

summary.description: One line, e.g. → ответ «Voice plugin»: вариант 2.

commands.title: Voice answer
commands.description: Voice session only: answer another agent session as the user. Give text for a plain answer, request with answers for a question (elicitation), or request with option for a permission request. Allowing a permission goes straight through only for the request in the utterance's context.session; allow_always, or allowing any other request, waits for the user's confirmation first. Non-destructive.

text.description: The user's answer, cleaned of fillers, repeats and recognition errors, meaning unchanged.

request.description: Question or permission request id from the context.

answers.description: Question answers by field key: a choice field takes one option value.

value.description: Option value or the typed answer.

option.description: optionId of the chosen permission option.

commands.title: Voice run
commands.description: Voice session only: run a dangerous Clubmate command for the user: a destructive agent-visible command or terminal input (session.send). It waits until the user confirms on the device they spoke from (at most 60 s); a decline fails with "the user declined". Other commands fail with "not dangerous": call them directly as MCP tools. Answers to sessions go through voice.answer instead. Returns the command's result.

command.description: Command id, e.g. git.worktree-remove or session.send.

args.description: Arguments of the command as JSON text (a string holding a JSON object).

summary.description: One line for the confirmation, in the user's language.

commands.title: Voice done
commands.description: Voice session only: finish the utterance with a short result in the user's language (what was done, or what was unclear). Always call it last. Non-destructive.

commands.title: Voice dictionary
commands.description: The user dictionary of replacements applied to recognized text: {entries: [{from, to}]}. Matching is whole-word, case-insensitive, longest from first.

commands.title: Set voice dictionary
commands.description: Replace the user dictionary; returns it as stored.

commands.title: Voice settings
commands.description: Whether voice input is on and which recognizer model it uses: {enabled, model, models: [{id, title, detail}]}. Off by default; while off no recognizer runs and voice.start fails with "voice is off". Changes publish voice.settings-changed with the same shape.

title.description: Name to show, e.g. Whisper small.

detail.description: What it is good at and about how much memory it takes.

commands.title: Set voice settings
commands.description: Turn voice input on or off and choose its model; returns the settings as stored. Turning it off stops the recognizer and frees its memory; a new model restarts it.

enabled.description: Turn voice input on or off.

model.description: Model id from voice.settings: nemotron or whisper-turbo.
